    THE COMPETITION

    What is Formula Student?

    Formula Student, known as Formula SAE outside Europe, is an international engineering competition in which university teams design, build, test and race a single seater car from scratch.

    It is not only a race. Teams are judged on the engineering behind the car, on the cost and manufacturing plan, and on a business case put to a panel of industry judges, so the competition rewards sound engineering and project management as much as outright speed.

    Universities from across the UK, Europe and the rest of the world compete against cars built the same way: by students, on student budgets, in roughly a year.

      STATIC EVENTS
    • Business Plan the case for the car as a product.
    • Cost and Manufacturing every part, costed and justified.
    • Engineering Design defending the design to judges.
      • DYNAMIC EVENTS
    • Acceleration 75 m standing start.
    • Skid Pad figure of eight.
    • Sprint one flying lap
    • Endurance 22 km
    • Efficiency energy over the endurance run
